mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes eplerenone, leading to increased eplerenone concentrations and hyperkalemia risk; additionally, both drugs can increase serum potassium through different mechanisms.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider dose reduction of eplerenone or use alternative aldosterone antagonist; counsel on potassium-rich foods and NSAIDs.
